businesses.business: gaming technology and content (slot machines, virtual sports, interactive games)

offering_description.value: Supplies gaming technology to regulated gaming operators: server-based slot machines and content, virtual sports, and online/interactive games. Customers are casinos, lotteries, betting shops, pubs and online operators. Revenue comes largely from recurring leases and revenue-share on installed machines and content.

primary_products.value: gaming machines (slot cabinets); server-based gaming systems; virtual sports content; digital game content; amusement-with-prizes machines

primary_services.value: interactive/online game content hosting; machine leasing and support; game and content licensing; systems maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: casinos, betting shop operators, pubs, arcades, lotteries, online gaming operators; B2G: government-run lotteries and state gaming authorities

end_markets.value: casino gaming; sports betting and virtual sports; lotteries; online gaming; pubs and arcades

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: recurring lease and participation fees on installed gaming machines; transaction or usage fees: revenue share on virtual sports and interactive content; licensing or royalties: licensed game content and systems; product sales: gaming machines and equipment sold outright
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; product sales

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and supplies gaming machines sold or leased to operators; software / platform: develops game content and server-based gaming systems for operators

geography_served.value: global: United Kingdom, Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: gaming machines, virtual sports, and interactive online games

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and leasing to casinos, betting operators, lotteries and pub groups; partners / resellers: content distributed via third-party online operators and aggregators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gaming licensing and equipment certification by gaming regulators such as UK Gambling Commission and US state gaming authorities
